description: Restore Tubi as a verified current free-with-ads option (confirmed live on Tubi's own listings and JustWatch as of Aug 2026) alongside Hulu/YouTube TV, which was incorrectly removed in an earlier patch

replacements.old: 2026 update: US streaming availability currently varies by film. Recent listings show several Twilight Saga titles on Hulu and YouTube TV, with free-with-ads options on The Roku Channel (and Pluto TV for Eclipse). Rental and purchase options are also available through major digital stores. Streaming libraries change, so verify the title on the service before watching.
replacements.new: 2026 update: All 5 Twilight Saga films are currently streaming free with ads on Tubi in the USA — no subscription needed. Twilight is also available on Hulu with a subscription. Rental and purchase options are available through major digital stores. Streaming libraries change, so verify the title on the service before watching.
